description: This file defines a custom ClassLoader (StubClassLoader) used in Apache Spark to generate stub classes for missing classes, primarily for handling lambdas with unknown classes. It includes logic for generating bytecode for stub classes that throw ClassNotFoundException when instantiated.

classes.name: StubClassLoader
classes.description: A custom ClassLoader that generates stub classes for missing classes marked for stubbing, used in Spark to handle unknown classes in lambdas.

methods.name: findClass
methods.description: Overrides ClassLoader.findClass to generate a stub class if the class should be stubbed.
